limitations: Twenty public 16 kHz clips: a smoke regression corpus, not native 48 kHz or owner microphone acceptance.
Quiet/noise are deterministic transformations; long means >=10 seconds, including repeated real utterances, not independent 60-second speech.
Cold is a fresh model/context, not a flushed OS cache. Quantiles span distinct clips and are not repeated same-clip jitter estimates.
CPU-only inference excludes microphone, Tauri, Windows insertion and Stop-to-ready application latency.
Source hashes identify the observed checkout; binary hashes do not attest its compiler provenance.

execution_evidence.host_load_note: Foreign cargo/MSBuild processes were observed by the parent agent; latency remains observational. No independent same-hardware baseline was supplied.

initial_attempt.reason_repeated: Review found that text/error-count consistency was not independently verified and an explicit latency baseline could use the same run. Final source fixes both; the initial numeric measurements are preserved rather than relabeled as final validation.
